in_marathi.name: Ansav
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ansav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ansav is a name derived from Sanskrit language. It means 'Answered' or 'Resolved'. In Hindu mythology, Ansav is a name of Lord Vishnu who is known as the preserver of the universe and the savior of all beings. The name carries the spiritual message of providing solace, guidance, and solutions to the problems of life.
